$comment: The machine-readable archetype table of reference/story/personas.md (the contract). Read by the validator (scripts/story/lib/persona.mts: persona-cover) and mirrored by member.archetype in the schema and ARCHETYPES in assets/story/types.ts; a test keeps all three equal. `rooms` are room roles (schema roomRole); `anchorRoles` are role ids (roles.json). The app pools are a starting point: the catalog (catalog-apps.json) decides what may be named at all.

organiser.label: Organiser
organiser.description: Runs the household and often a small business from a home office: planning, files and paperwork.

builder.label: Builder
builder.description: Writes software for a living, laptop on the desk: the code and a local model both live on the Core.

gamer.label: Gamer
gamer.description: Plays on the Core from the couch or the bedroom: Steam Headless streams to a screen in the house.

learner.label: Learner
learner.description: Studies and reads: homework, languages and exams with local tools.

maker.label: Maker
maker.description: Paints, photographs, writes or plays; the household's creative work lives on the Core.

host.label: Host
host.description: Feeds, ferries, waters and tidies the house: the household's shared beats.
